description: ui-health implements `PreviewFix`/`ApplyFix` RPCs plus a `ui-health fix <scenario> [--apply] [--rule] [--path] [--json]` CLI. A safe mechanical subset of findings is fixable while risky transforms remain report-only. `test-genie fix ui-health --deterministic` picks up these fixers. An absent `fix_class` defaults to manual, and every manual finding carries a reason.

requirements.description: ui-health must expose `PreviewFix` and `ApplyFix` RPCs and a `ui-health fix <scenario> [--apply] [--rule] [--path] [--json]` CLI. PreviewFix returns the proposed change without writing; ApplyFix (or --apply) writes the change. An absent fix_class defaults to manual, and every manual finding must carry a human-readable reason.
requirements.title: PreviewFix/ApplyFix RPCs + fix CLI

validation.notes: PreviewFix returns the proposed change without modifying any file
ApplyFix writes the change; an absent fix_class defaults to manual and carries a reason
The fix CLI honors --apply, --rule, --path, and --json flags
Run `ui-health fix <scenario> --json` (preview) and confirm proposed changes are listed with no files written
Run `ui-health fix <scenario> --apply` and confirm the safe change is written and the finding clears on re-validate
Every manual finding explains why it cannot be auto-fixed

requirements.description: Only a safe mechanical subset of findings is auto-fixable; risky transforms remain report-only. Safe fixers must be idempotent (re-applying produces no further change), and `test-genie fix ui-health --deterministic` must pick up these fixers.
requirements.title: Idempotent safe fixers + test-genie deterministic-fix integration

validation.notes: Safe mechanical findings are marked autofix_available; risky transforms are report-only
Applying a safe fixer twice produces no change on the second run (idempotent)
Run `test-genie fix ui-health --deterministic` and confirm ui-health's safe fixers are invoked
Re-running the deterministic fix leaves the tree unchanged after the first application
Deterministic auto-fix safely reduces UI-health findings without touching risky transforms

title: Deterministic auto-fix
